title: Pure sorptivity-event state and absorbed-potential equation

source.behavior: Apply saturation-deficit guard; initialize or continue/end sorptivity event state; calculate event amount from square-root time increment and geometry; optionally apply wall-wetting factor; cap by 1e3*dt*dz.

scope: start/continue/end/wet states, wall factor and peak cap
non_goals: legacy ABSORPTION mutable state owner, Darcy/diffusion route or task-2 derivatives
accepted mass receipt, rollback/restart or runtime admission
